finding.root_cause: The /admin/schedule HTML shell used the legacy global users.role editor check even while site-membership enforcement was enabled, while the central ingress did not require a same-site editor grant for that route.
finding.impact: A global viewer with an active site-editor grant was incorrectly denied, while a global editor without an active same-site grant could fetch the HTML shell.

change.behavior: When site-membership enforcement is active, /admin/schedule requires an active same-site editor grant at Worker ingress; anonymous HTML requests keep the login redirect; the legacy global role check remains only when the gate is disabled.

production.migration_gate: PASS; the safe deployment command did not apply migrations
production.asset_upload: Cloudflare reported no updated asset files to upload

health_check.note: Direct GET requests to the production Worker health and asset URLs were blocked by Cloudflare 1010. Worker deployment/version/traffic and exact source SHA were verified via the Cloudflare API.
